title: On the mechanical and electrical properties of copper-silver and copper-silver-zirconium alloys deposits manufactured by cold spray
InformationInFigures: Yes. Heat treated samples results values and temperature during treatment (Figs. 2,3,4) and powder morphology (Fig. 1a)

preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: cylindrical mandrels were degreased and grit-blasted

experimentalProperties.Deposition_Area_Dimensions: Cylindrical mandrel: 49.7 mm diameter, 150 mm long, 3-4 mm thick
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Deposits were prepared on cylindrical mandrels (49.7 mm in diameter x 150 mm long). After deposition, the steel mandrels were removed by machining thus leaving copper alloys cylinders. tensile samples NOL ring samples, machined to 3-4 mm thick and 10 mm high.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: powder particles do not undergo melting and quenching and hence no visible change in the phase repartition occurs. Heavily deformed particles and dense microstructure (porosity measured below 0.1% per image analysis) can be observed

Experiments.Notes: As-spray Pure Cu. nozzle pressure, gas flow rate, powder feed rate, and spray distance were all given as a range where samples are not reported with a specific value attached. It was also noted that nozzle pressure in particular did not have a significant effect which is why comparisons related to pressure were not made.
